boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Scripps destinations for studying, making, gathering, and taking a slower look at the campus’s shared spaces.

cards.title: Pause beside Seal Court
cards.subtitle: Malott Commons, Scripps College
cards.notes: Meet at the fountain before or after a Malott stop, then use the surrounding tables and benches for a low-key outdoor catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A fountain courtyard with seating beside Malott Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: A Scripps student admission-ambassador feature describes Seal Court’s fountain and its surrounding benches, chairs, and tables for hanging out and studying.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor seating is described by Scripps; follow posted campus access and event-use rules.

cards.title: Look closely in Margaret Fowler Garden
cards.subtitle: Scripps College campus
cards.notes: Walk the cloister-style garden with a friend and pause at the murals, fountain, and outdoor seating rather than treating it as a shortcut.
cards.short_summary: A walled garden with art, a fountain, and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps identifies Margaret Fowler Garden as a medieval-style cloister garden; its student feature documents murals, a fountain, and outdoor seating.
cards.source_title: Top 5 Hidden Gems at Scripps College
cards.access_notes: The College lists the garden as an outdoor event venue; respect reservations and any posted restrictions.

cards.title: Set up at Denison Library
cards.subtitle: Scripps College special collections library
cards.notes: Bring a campus ID for a quiet study session, or arrange rare-materials research ahead when your project needs the College archives.
cards.short_summary: Special collections, archives, and study space in one historic library.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Library states that current Claremont Colleges students, faculty, and staff may use it for study space and identifies its Scripps archives and special collections.
cards.access_notes: Current Claremont Colleges ID is required for study-space access; rare-materials consultation requires advance contact.

cards.title: Read in Toll’s browsing room
cards.subtitle: Toll Hall, Scripps College
cards.notes: If you have residence-hall access, take a book or coursework to this named browsing room and leave it as you found it for others.
cards.short_summary: A named residential study room with shelves of left-behind books.
cards.evidence_claim: A Scripps student admission-ambassador feature identifies Toll Hall’s browsing room as an additional study space with books left by prior students.
cards.access_notes: The same Scripps feature says access is limited to Scripps students or people accompanied by one.

cards.title: Take a blanket to Star Court
cards.subtitle: Toll Hall, Scripps College
cards.notes: Use the lawn for a daytime reading break or conversation, keeping paths clear and following residence-hall and campus quiet-hour expectations.
cards.short_summary: A grassy court at Toll Hall for an unhurried outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: A Scripps student admission-ambassador feature identifies Star Court in Toll Hall and describes using its grass for lounging or reading.
cards.access_notes: Located at a residence hall; use is subject to resident access and campus policies.

cards.title: Choose your floor at Honnold/Mudd
cards.subtitle: 800 N. Dartmouth Avenue, Claremont
cards.notes: Reserve a group room for collaborative work, or choose the quiet fourth floor when you need a focused stretch between classes.
cards.short_summary: A shared 5C library with group rooms and quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: A Scripps admission-ambassador feature says Honnold/Mudd has study spaces and reservable group meeting spaces, describing its fourth floor as a quiet study area.
cards.access_notes: A consortium library beside Scripps; consult the library for current building access and room-reservation procedures.

cards.title: Make time for the Clark Humanities Museum
cards.subtitle: Edwards Humanities Building, Scripps College
cards.notes: Visit an exhibition with a classmate and use the objects on view as a prompt for discussion, sketching, or a short reflective break.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum where students encounter art and artifacts.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps describes the Clark Humanities Museum as a space where students engage with art and artifacts as part of academic learning.
cards.source_title: Top 5 Hidden Gems at Scripps College
cards.access_notes: Listed on Scripps’s campus map in the Edwards Humanities Building; check the museum for exhibition access.

cards.title: Walk the Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: Millard Sheets Art Center, Scripps College
cards.notes: Add this outdoor art stop to a walk through the arts area, pausing to look before heading into the adjacent studios or gallery.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor art destination in Scripps’s Millard Sheets Art Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps’s campus map lists the Sculpture Garden as part of the Millard Sheets Art Center complex.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus destination; respect any art-installation boundaries and event setup.

cards.title: Cross Jaqua Quadrangle slowly
cards.subtitle: Scripps College campus
cards.notes: Use the quad as a meeting point between classes, then take a few minutes to sit, talk, or orient yourself using the campus map.
cards.short_summary: A named central quadrangle on the Scripps campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps’s official campus map identifies Jaqua Quadrangle as a named campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; access and setup may change for College events.

cards.title: Regroup on Elm Tree Lawn
cards.subtitle: Scripps College campus
cards.notes: Bring a classmate for a short outdoor reset between commitments, and keep your visit flexible around campus programming or grounds work.
cards.short_summary: A named lawn among Scripps’s reservable outdoor spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps lists Elm Tree Lawn among its named outdoor spaces and identifies it on the official campus map.
cards.access_notes: The College includes this lawn in its outdoor-space inventory; respect scheduled events and posted campus rules.
